preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 100, inclusive.
The size of each array is between 5 and 500, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: Each array is a permutation of integers from 1 to n
preconditions.description: Each array in the input is a permutation of integers from 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 500
preconditions.description: The total number of elements across all arrays does not exceed 500.

postconditions.expression: The first line of the output contains the number of good subsets modulo 998244353
postconditions.description: The first line of the output is the count of good subsets, modulo 998244353.

postconditions.expression: The second line of the output contains n indices of the arrays forming a good subset
postconditions.description: The second line of the output contains n indices of the arrays that form a Latin square.

invariants.expression: The input arrays are permutations and form a Latin square when considered as a matrix
invariants.description: The input arrays are permutations and when arranged as a matrix, each row and each column is a permutation of 1 to n.

invariants.expression: The additional n arrays do not form a Latin square
invariants.description: The additional n arrays are not arranged in such a way that each row and each column is a permutation of 1 to n.

invariants.expression: No two arrays in the input are identical
invariants.description: There are no two arrays in the input that are identical.
